boundaries: Decision Request Set is interaction aggregation, not authority aggregation.
Every request remains independently challengeable and invalidatable.
The set cannot contain an inferred decision.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines presentation aggregation only. It does not create, approve, combine, or execute any authority-bearing decision.

scope.applicability: A closed presentation set of independently governed decision requests at one Decision Checkpoint.
exclusions: A replacement for individual decision records.
Requests whose exact targets do not yet exist.

examples: Present independently identified definition and registry-postimage decisions at one checkpoint.
Do not include exact-output publication approval before the output bytes exist.
domain_context.explanation: Craft may present definition and registry decisions together when all exact targets exist, without pretending they are one governance decision.

plain_language.explanation: Several exact questions shown together once. The user sees one interaction, but every question keeps its own owner, target, and consequence.

boundary_conditions: A shared principal does not collapse member roles.
One approved member does not approve another.
A request without its exact target cannot enter the set.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: RequestSet(R,c) iff FiniteClosed(R) and forall r in R: Checkpoint(r)=c and ExactOwner(r) and ExactTarget(r) and ExactEffect(r); Authorized(R) iff forall r in R: Authorized(r).
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Decision Request Set is a closed ordered set of exact decision requests presented at one Decision Checkpoint. Every member retains its independent decision identity, authority scope, owner, target, digest when bytes exist, requested effect, outcome, and invalidation conditions. Presentation reduces interaction count but cannot merge authority, infer authorization between members, or let one outcome satisfy another gate.

notation.meaning: One closed presentation set of decision requests.
The single Decision Checkpoint presenting the set.

testable_conditions: Every member has a unique decision identity.
Every member binds owner, target, effect, and scope.
All members name the same checkpoint without merging authority.
